pA.#comment: A: image row and one monospace row, no conditions, no locals.

pB.#comment: B: the same rows with show_condition on the local TIP_SHOW (value 0 set before).

pC.#comment: C: text rows whose text takes locals as params (set before).

pD.#comment: D: a monospace row of 50 characters, then see where it wraps.

pE.#comment: E: 49 characters row above the bar, to see the page layout.

set_dispatch.text: The row above has 49 characters, the bar sits below it.

show results.#comment: Page with the values written by the thread tests.

set_dispatch.text: T3 text with params in set: {0}

tip page.#comment: F: page with the bar and three monospace tip rows that take its place in turn (TIP_SHOW 0 = bar, 1..3 = tip rows).

set_dispatch.text: SAY: SHOW BRIEFING | HIDE BRIEFING | PATIENT ONE
Ruler of 49 characters below. Does the page below move when the bar changes to text?
Normal text, same words as the tip line: SAY: SHOW BRIEFING | HIDE BRIEFING | PATIENT ONE
Content row A. If this row moves when the bar and the tip alternate, the layout is not stable.

tip rotation.#comment: Every 5 s: 0 bar, 1 tip, 0 bar, 2 tip, 0 bar, 3 tip. TIP_LINE (row 3) is composed from two parts and changed each round to see whether a row follows a local live.

pG.#comment: G: bar or tip row with a transparent spacer of 0/6/12/18/24 px under the tip row, switched live by buttons (no rebuild).

set_dispatch.text: Content row A: watch whether this row moves when you switch BAR and TIP.
Ruler of 60 characters: where does the monospace row wrap?

pH.#comment: H: the status bar without its gray part (rows 20-33 of the 34 px image are the dark reflection): bar of 34, 22 or 20 px against the tip row, switched live.

set_dispatch.text: Content row A: watch whether this row moves when you switch BAR and TIP.

briefing.text: Press the buttons one by one. Report which one shows Command Failed. Each opens a page, use BACK.

buttonbar.title: B: rows with show_condition on a local
C: text rows with local params
T2: while loop in a thread
T3: set with a text and params
T4: set with if then/else numbers
F: ALTERNATION (press once, then wait 60 s)
G: SPACER TEST (switch BAR/TIP and spacer)
H: BAR WITHOUT THE GRAY PART
